# QA Testing Blueprints (QA-11X v3.12 — @sinfallas/mcp-qa-11x v3.12.0)

> Zero-Infra Agentic QA, Dual-Mode AI Evals, FINOS CALM Architecture-as-Code, and DevSecOps Governance Blueprint (`MIT`). Enforces serialized non-root ephemeral Docker execution (`Rule Zero`, `QA_MAX_CONCURRENT_CONTAINERS=1`, `sinfallas/*`, `Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL = 0`, thermal/RAM & CrashLoop guardrails), `>= 95%` unit coverage, `CC <= 5`, multi-role Screenplay E2E, Pact V4 contracts, `k6` load smoke, and 22 DISA ASD STIG V6R5 + OWASP Developer Guide v4.2 reference controls (enforced via 37 static scanner rules including `QA-DOCKER-LOOP-01`) across 28 AI coding agents with SHA-256 manifest verification.

## Quickstart (30s)

- Bootstrap any repository in under 30 seconds without cloning this monorepo: `npx -y @sinfallas/mcp-qa-11x@latest quickstart`
- Progressive adoption tiers (`.qa-11x.json` v3; unified non-interactive/CI default = `standard`, interactive TTY prompt in `quickstart`, status banner `[QA-11X | Tier: <tier> | Path: <DOCS_ONLY|MICRO_CHANGE|FULL_11X>]`): `starter` (day-1 secrets, `.qa-11x.json` v3, `AGENTS.md`, assisted contextual governance templates), `standard` (PR AST blast-radius CI, `QA-UI-ANTI-001..005` anti-pattern lint, SARIF security audit, project `qa-lint`/`lint`; `>= 95%` coverage and strict typing via stack Makefile/CI), and `enterprise` (PR FINOS CALM + certify gates; full 13-layer pyramid, PostgreSQL 17 RLS + WORM `seq_num`, Pact V4 + k6, and Release Gate via CI/Makefile).
- Multi-agent and language support (`28` AI coding agents, `--lang auto|en|es`, `--agents auto|all`, `--tier starter|standard|enterprise`, `--governance-docs`, `--decline-governance-docs`, `--bilingual-mirrors`, `--dry-run`).
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/README.md) (`README.md`) — English-first project overview, Docker matrix, and 30-second quickstart.
- [README.es.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/README.es.md) (`README.es.md`) — Full Spanish mirror and testing tools matrix.
- [docs/agent-setup.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/docs/agent-setup.md) (`docs/agent-setup.md`) — Setup matrix for 28 AI coding agents and MCP clients (Spanish mirror: `docs/agent-setup.es.md`).

- [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/SECURITY.md) (`SECURITY.md`) — Security policy, supported versions, and 34 defense-in-depth requirements (`DISA ASD STIG V6R5`, `OWASP v4.2`, and `QA-DOCKER-LOOP-01`).
- [TESTING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/TESTING.md) (`TESTING.md`) — Live certification scoreboard, ephemeral Docker test suites, and coverage evidence.

## MCP Server (`@sinfallas/mcp-qa-11x` v3.12.0 — MIT, Zero-Infra)

- [mcp-server/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/mcp-server/README.md) (`mcp-server/README.md`) — Official npm package documentation (`@sinfallas/mcp-qa-11x@3.12.0`), runtime security guards, and all 12 CLI subcommands (`quickstart`, `init-agents`, `install-skill`, `reconcile-agents`, `tms-sync`, `doctor`, `upgrade`, `certify`, `audit`, `blast-radius`, `mcp-config`, `completion`).
- [.agents/scripts/bump_version_11x.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/scripts/bump_version_11x.py) (`.agents/scripts/bump_version_11x.py`) — Deterministic Zero-LLM version and edition synchronizer (`--check` / `--set`).
- [mcp-server/src/a2a/agentCard.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/mcp-server/src/a2a/agentCard.ts) (`mcp-server/src/a2a/agentCard.ts`) — Agent2Agent (`A2A`) capability descriptor (`task-capacity` extension, 12 skills, `QA-GIT-GATE-01`).
- [mcp-server/src/security/promptGuard.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/mcp-server/src/security/promptGuard.ts) (`mcp-server/src/security/promptGuard.ts`) — Fail-closed `tools/call` interceptor (`NFKC` canonicalization, Trojan Source stripping, injection & `QA-GIT-GATE-01` bypass blocking, PII redaction).
- [mcp-server/src/utils/taskStateGuard.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/mcp-server/src/utils/taskStateGuard.ts) (`mcp-server/src/utils/taskStateGuard.ts`) — Bounded concurrency state machine (`AVAILABLE | BUSY | BROKEN`), `AbortController` timeouts, and 0-byte artifact cleanup.
- **12 CLI Subcommands (`npx -y @sinfallas/mcp-qa-11x <cmd>`):** `quickstart`, `init-agents`, `install-skill`, `reconcile-agents`, `tms-sync`, `doctor` (alias: `status`), `upgrade` (alias: `cache-clean`), `certify`, `audit`, `blast-radius`, `mcp-config`, `completion`.
- **20 MCP Tools (`tools/list` — 12 core v1 + 6 v2.0 + v3.1 `session_flight_recorder` + `analyze_ecosystem_specs`):** `inspect_project_config`, `fetch_blueprint_bundle`, `bootstrap_or_merge_11x`, `inspect_ast_blast_radius`, `clean_workspace_11x`, `audit_security_stig_owasp`, `run_ephemeral_qa`, `certify_11x_gate`, `audit_test_pyramid_gaps`, `init_or_append_agents_md`, `propose_skill_evolution_pr`, `reconcile_agents_governance`, `validate_calm_architecture`, `evaluate_release_gate`, `evaluate_agent_trajectory`, `run_llm_red_team`, `audit_vibe_prototype`, `sync_enterprise_tms`, `session_flight_recorder`, `analyze_ecosystem_specs`.
- **13 MCP Resources (`blueprint://*` — including v3.1 `blueprint://skills/tactical-patterns-11x`):** `blueprint://manifest`, `blueprint://core/philosophy`, `blueprint://security/disa-owasp-22`, `blueprint://database/postgres-rls-worm`, `blueprint://{stack}/readme` (`python`, `fastapi`, `node-backend`, `vue3`, `react-frontend`, `bash-scripts`, `php`, `mobile-appium`, `ai-evals`, `vibe-rescue`), `blueprint://ui/refactoring-ui/{topic}`, `blueprint://core/active-task-template`, `blueprint://core/cleanup-script`, `blueprint://core/roadmap-validator`, `blueprint://ai/evals-redteam`, `blueprint://mobile-appium/readme`, `blueprint://vibe-rescue/readme`, `blueprint://skills/tactical-patterns-11x`.

## 12 Modular AI Agent Skills (`< 20 KB` each)

- [qa-11x-architect](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-architect/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-architect/SKILL.md`, `<= 12 KB`) — Master routing orchestrator; invoke for 3-path selection, 13-layer pyramid planning, `.example` merges, and `TESTING.md`/`CHANGELOG.md` governance.
- [qa-11x-devsecops-hardener](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-devsecops-hardener/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-devsecops-hardener/SKILL.md`) — Invoke when designing or auditing PostgreSQL 15–17+ RLS schemas, auth/session flows, AES-GCM vaults, WORM audit chains, or mutating MCP tools.
- [qa-11x-systematic-debugging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-systematic-debugging/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-systematic-debugging/SKILL.md`) — Invoke before fixing bugs, test failures, regressions, or runtime issues via 4-phase Docker reproduction and RED-to-GREEN locks.
- [qa-11x-screenplay-builder](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-screenplay-builder/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-screenplay-builder/SKILL.md`) — Invoke for multi-role RBAC E2E suites, semantic self-healing ARIA locators, Anti-JSDOM geometry, Anti-Silo checks, and 3-phase temporal assertions.
- [qa-11x-llm-evaluator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-llm-evaluator/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-llm-evaluator/SKILL.md`) — Invoke for dual-mode RAG, agent trajectory, WebRTC voice latency, PDF/OCR fidelity evals, and Promptfoo OWASP LLM Top 10 red-teaming.
- [qa-11x-vibe-rescue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-vibe-rescue/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-vibe-rescue/SKILL.md`) — Invoke when auditing or hardening AI-generated prototypes (Bolt.new, Lovable, v0, Replit) without breaking their UX.
- [qa-11x-docker-certifier](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-docker-certifier/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-docker-certifier/SKILL.md`) — Invoke to run ephemeral `Rule Zero` test/lint/mutation/a11y certification (`>= 95%` coverage, `CC <= 5`, WCAG 2.1 AA, Lighthouse CI).
- [docker-trivy-keydb-hardening](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/docker-trivy-keydb-hardening/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/docker-trivy-keydb-hardening/SKILL.md`) — Invoke for non-root Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, `Trivy HIGH/CRITICAL = 0` hardening, and KeyDB multi-threaded caching.
- [graphify-ast-navigator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/graphify-ast-navigator/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/graphify-ast-navigator/SKILL.md`) — Mandatory first step before Code Q&A or refactoring to inspect `graph.json`/`GRAPH_REPORT.md` callers, callees, and layer boundaries.
- [refactoring-ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/refactoring-ui/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/refactoring-ui/SKILL.md`) — Invoke when building or restyling interfaces for spacing, typography, OKLCH contrast (`WCAG 2.1 AA`), dark mode, and in-flow layouts.
- [tactical-patterns-11x](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/tactical-patterns-11x/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/tactical-patterns-11x/SKILL.md`, `<= 2.5 KB`) — JIT tactical design patterns on complexity/lint failures (`CC <= 5`, `SonarJS <= 15`, `max-params: 4`, offline Port/Adapter, Transactional Outbox).
- [qa-11x-reverse-specs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/.agents/skills/qa-11x-reverse-specs/SKILL.md) (`.agents/skills/qa-11x-reverse-specs/SKILL.md`) — Zero-footprint multi-project reverse specifications, cross-project HTTP/`.env` contract mapping, and functional/AST inconsistency reporting without vulnerability audits.

## 10 Production Blueprints

> Matrix scope: **10 hydratable stacks** below + `architecture/` (FINOS CALM topology) + `mcp-server/` (`@sinfallas/mcp-qa-11x`) = **12 matrix environments**.

- [python/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/python/README.md) (`python/README.md`) — Standalone Python libraries and CLIs (`uv`, `ruff CC <= 5`, `mypy --strict`, `pytest >= 95%`, Hypothesis, Mutmut, Bandit).
- [fastapi/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/fastapi/README.md) (`fastapi/README.md`) — Async FastAPI services (`PostgreSQL 17` RLS + Alembic parity, Pact V4 consumer, Grafana `k6` smoke, Karate API BDD).
- [node-backend/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/node-backend/README.md) (`node-backend/README.md`) — Node.js/TypeScript APIs (`ESLint --max-warnings 0`, Vitest `>= 95%`, Pact V4 provider verifier, Stryker, ZAP).
- [vue3/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/vue3/README.md) (`vue3/README.md`) — Vue 3 + Vite frontends (Screenplay `Actor.ts`, Self-Healing DOM `semanticLocator.ts`, Vitest `>= 95%`, `@axe-core`, Lighthouse CI).
- [react-frontend/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/react-frontend/README.md) (`react-frontend/README.md`) — React + Vite frontends (Screenplay `Actor.ts`, Self-Healing DOM `semanticLocator.ts`, RTL, Playwright, `@axe-core`).
- [php/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/php/README.md) (`php/README.md`) — PHP 8.2–8.5 services (`PHP-CS-Fixer`, `PHPStan max`, `Psalm --taint-analysis`, `Pest`/`PHPUnit` + PCOV `>= 95%`, Infection).
- [bash-scripts/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/bash-scripts/README.md) (`bash-scripts/README.md`) — POSIX/Bash DevOps automation (`ShellCheck`, `shfmt`, `BATS-core`, `bats-mock`, `kcov >= 95%`).
- [ai-evals/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/ai-evals/README.md) (`ai-evals/README.md`) — Dual-mode AI evals (RAG faithfulness, Promptfoo OWASP LLM Top 10, WebRTC voice latency, PDF/OCR `Decimal` tables, `golden_from_traces.py`).
- [mobile-appium/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/mobile-appium/README.md) (`mobile-appium/README.md`) — Native & hybrid mobile QA (Appium 3 + WebdriverIO `wdio.conf.ts`, `MobileActor.ts` for Android, iOS, Ionic, React Native).
- [vibe-rescue/](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tecno-consultores/qa-testing-blueprints/main/vibe-rescue/README.md) (`vibe-rescue/README.md`) — Vibe-to-Enterprise hardening (`audit_vibe_prototype.py`, `VIBE-SEC-001..QA-005`, PostgreSQL 17 RLS/WORM template).
